title: "96 Well Plate_4.1"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(paletteer)
library(gt)
library(scales)
```

# Data cleaning

```{r}
#data from the 96well table
#time is in minutes
well <- read_excel("96Well_result.xlsx", sheet = "96OD") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -1, names_to = "time", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(time = as.integer(time))
```

```{r}
#strain reference to well lables
reference <- read_excel("96Well_result.xlsx", sheet = "strain_reference")
```

```{r}
#hide this
interesting1190 <- well %>%
  filter(sample == c("A3", "A11"))


interestingBZB <- well %>%
  filter(sample == c("B2", "A10", "A2", "B10"))
```

```{r}
#use this for table: raw data + strain lable
wellComplete <- left_join(well, reference, by = "sample")
```

#Drawing killing curves

```{r}
#all BZB
allBZB <- wellComplete %>%
   filter(str_starts(strain, "BZB_"))

#replicates subgroup
BZB_A <- allBZB %>%
filter(str_starts(sample, "A"))
BZB_B <- allBZB %>%
filter(str_starts(sample, "B"))
BZB_C <- allBZB %>%
filter(str_starts(sample, "C"))
BZB_D <- allBZB %>%
filter(str_starts(sample, "D"))
```

```{r}
#line chart time-killing curve
ggplot(BZB_A, aes(x=time, y=value, color = strain))+
  geom_path() +
  labs(title = "Time-killing curve for BZB")
```

```{r}
#all 1190
all1190 <- wellComplete %>%
   filter(str_starts(strain, "1190_"))

#1190 replicates subgroups
EL90_E <- all1190 %>%
filter(str_starts(sample, "E"))
EL90F <- all1190 %>%
filter(str_starts(sample, "F"))
EL90_G <- all1190 %>%
filter(str_starts(sample, "G"))
EL90_H <- all1190 %>%
filter(str_starts(sample, "H"))
```

```{r}
#line chart time-killing curve
ggplot(EL90_E, aes(x=time, y=value, color = strain))+
  geom_path() +
  labs(title = "Time-killing curve for E_1190")
```

```{r}
#calculate coefficient of variation
CI_BZB <- allBZB %>%
  group_by(strain, time) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(CV = sd/mean)

```

```{r}
CI_1190 <- all1190 %>%
  group_by(strain, time) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(CV = sd/mean)

```

```{r}
#coefficient of variation over time
CI_BZB %>%
  #filter (strain == "BZB_100E") %>%
ggplot(aes(x=time, y=CV, color = strain))+
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~strain) +
  labs (title = "Coefficient of variation over time for BZB")
```

```{r}
#coefficient of variation over time
CI_1190 %>%
  #filter (strain == "BZB_100E") %>%
ggplot(aes(x=time, y=CV, color = strain))+
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~strain) +
  labs (title = "Coefficient of variation over time for E_1190")
```
